prompt: Show wiki status / delta for a labeled temp vault with a few new and modified sources. Report only — do not ingest or rebuild.
expected_output: Wiki Status report: Overview, Delta (New/Modified/Unchanged/Deleted), Summary with append-vs-rebuild recommendation, Token Footprint, What to Do Next. No destructive rebuild.

assertions.text: Uses python3 scripts/manifest.py stats/list/delta/has/get — never reads the whole .manifest.json into context
Status report includes Overview, Delta tables (new/modified/unchanged/deleted), Summary, and What to Do Next (≤6 ranked items)
Token Footprint uses python3 scripts/token-count.py (tiktoken) — never file_size/4 heuristics
Recommends append vs rebuild but does not run wiki-rebuild or archive the vault
Standard status mode does not modify wiki pages (report-only except insights mode's regenerable _insights.md)
